name: The Ossuary — Anonymous Deep Board Network
description: The Ossuary is GLMZ's most significant unmoderated anonymous board network, accessible through the standard net via obfuscated routing but fully inhabiting the Underworld at its deeper layers. Organized into 'Crypts' — topic-specific boards ranging from political whistleblowing and synthetic rights organizing to black market listings and raw extremist content — The Ossuary operates on a dead-drop architecture where no post is traceable to an origin node. It was built in 2189 by an anonymous collective using the collective signature 'The Sexton' and has had no identifiable administrator since. Corporate security divisions, MERIT enforcement, and three corponation intelligence arms all maintain covert monitoring presences, which The Ossuary community actively works to identify and humiliate.
cultural_impact: The Ossuary has been the origin point of four major corponation scandal leaks in the last decade and serves as the primary organizing infrastructure for Shelf-based mutual aid networks, making it simultaneously the most dangerous and most vital communication space in M88 for Tier 1 residents.
key_figures: The Sexton (anonymous founding collective, identity unknown)
Bonekeeper (prominent anonymous Crypt moderator, Whistleblower Crypts)
MERIT Agent Designate 'Crowbar' (known undercover presence, identity debated)
locations: Underworld server cluster, routing through defunct infrastructure in Shelf Ward 3
Physical dead-drop points in Ward 7 and Ward 11 for offline verification
Mirror nodes maintained in three unknown locations outside M88
story_hooks: A Crypt dedicated to synthetic rights organizing begins receiving posts that are clearly from an infiltrated source — but the community's attempts to root out the mole are themselves being monitored and used to map the network's human members

The Sexton breaks years of silence with a single post: a data package too large to be a message, addressed to a specific anonymous ID that nobody can identify — and every major player in M88 wants to know what's inside

A player character receives an Ossuary dead-drop containing evidence of their own manufactured criminal record — someone has been building a false Ossuary history for them for months, and they have no idea why
user_base: Estimated 200,000-600,000 unique visitors monthly (verification impossible by design); heaviest use from Tier 1-2 residents, journalists, corporate espionage operatives, and law enforcement
monetization: No monetization; infrastructure costs covered by anonymous cryptocurrency donations and distributed hosting by volunteer nodes
notable_feature: Crypt Archaeology — the practice of excavating deleted posts through redundant node caching, a community skill set that has recovered critical evidence multiple times and spawned a subculture of amateur digital archaeologists
related_entities: Helix Biosystems Tracheal Anchor Kit — 'The Sexton'
